description_en: Queries the list of DNS records under a site, including record values, priorities, authentication configurations, etc. Supports filtering by conditions such as record name and record type
description_zh: 查询站点下解析记录列表，包括记录值、优先级、认证配置等。支持根据记录名称、记录类型等条件进行过滤
name: ListRecords

parameters.help_en: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html API
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: Record name. Used as a filter condition for queries
parameters.help_zh: 记录名称。用于查询的过滤条件
parameters.name: record_name

parameters.help_en:
The search matching mode for record names. Defaults to exact match. Valid values:

prefix: Prefix match.
suffix: Suffix match.
exact: Exact match.
fuzzy: Fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh:
记录名称的搜索匹配模式。默认为精确匹配，取值：

prefix：前缀匹配。
suffix：后缀匹配。
exact：精确匹配。
fuzzy：模糊匹配
parameters.name: record_match_type

parameters.help_en: The page number for paginated queries. The value must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，第几页，取值大于等于 1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paginated queries. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页大小，取值范围 1-500。默认值：500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The origin type of the record. Used as a filter condition for queries (only CNAME records can be filtered by this field). Valid values:
OSS: OSS origin.
S3: S3 origin.
LB: Load balancer origin.
OP: Origin pool.
Domain: Standard domain origin
parameters.help_zh:
记录的源站类型，用于查询的过滤条件（仅CNAME记录可以通过该字段筛选），取值：
OSS：OSS源站。
S3：S3源站。
LB：负载均衡器源站。
OP：源地址池源站。
Domain：普通域名源站
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The business scenario for record acceleration. Used as a filter condition for queries. Valid values:
image_video: Image and video.
api: API.
web: Web page
parameters.help_zh:
记录加速时的业务场景，用于查询的过滤条件，取值：
image_video：视频图片。
api：api接口。
web：web网页
parameters.name: biz_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether proxy acceleration is enabled for the record. Used as a filter condition for queries. Valid values:

true: Proxy enabled.
false: Proxy acceleration disabled
parameters.help_zh:
记录是否开启代理加速，用于查询的过滤条件。取值：

true：开启代理。
false：关闭代理加速
parameters.name: proxied

parameters.help_en: The DNS record type of the record. Used as a filter condition for queries
parameters.help_zh: 记录的DNS记录类型，用于查询的过滤条件
parameters.name: type

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number, same as the PageNumber request parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页码，同请求参数的 PageNumber

PageSize.description_en: The number of records displayed per page

Records.description_en: DNS information of the records. For details, refer to <props="china">[Documentation]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2708761.html）</props><props="intl">Documentation (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/2708761.html)</props>
Records.description_zh: 记录的DNS信息，详情请参考<props="china">[说明文档]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2708761.html）</props><props="intl">说明文档 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/2708761.html)</props>

AuthConf.description_en: The origin authentication information of the CNAME record

AccessKey.description_en: The AccessKey of the account to which the origin belongs. This parameter is available when the origin type is OSS with private cross-account read authentication, or when the origin type is S3 with private read authentication
AccessKey.description_zh: 源站所属账号的AccessKey，当源站类型为OSS且源站鉴权类型为私有跨账号读，或者源站类型为S3且源站鉴权类型为私有读时有该参数

AuthType.description_en:
The origin authentication type. Different origin types support different authentication types. The origin type refers to the SourceType parameter in this API. When the origin type is OSS or S3, the origin authentication type must be specified. Valid values:
public: Public read. Use this value when the origin type is OSS or S3 and the origin has public read access.
private: Private read. Use this value when the origin type is S3 and the origin has private read access.
private_same_account: Private same-account read. Use this value when the origin type is OSS, the origin is under the same Alibaba Cloud account, and the origin has private read access.
private_cross_account: Private cross-account read. Use this value when the origin type is OSS, the origin is not under the same Alibaba Cloud account, and the origin has private read access
AuthType.description_zh:
源站鉴权类型，不同的源站类型，支持的鉴权类型不同，源站类型是指本接口中的SourceType参数，现在源站类型为OSS和S3时，需要填写源站鉴权类型，可选值：
public：公共读，当源站类型为OSS或S3，且源站为公共读时为该参数。
private: 私有读，当源站类型为S3，且源站为私有读时为该参数。
private_same_account: 私有同账号读，当源站类型为OSS，在同一个阿里云账号下，且源站为私有读时为该参数。
private_cross_account: 私有跨账号读，当源站类型为OSS，不在同一个阿里云账号下，且源站为私有读时为该参数

Region.description_en: The region where the origin is located. This parameter is available when the origin type is S3. The region of the origin can be obtained from the official S3 website
Region.description_zh: 源站所属区域，当源站类型为S3时有该参数，源站所属的区域需要在S3的官方网站上获取

SecretKey.description_en: The SecretKey of the account to which the origin belongs. This parameter is available when the origin type is OSS with private cross-account read authentication, or when the origin type is S3 with private read authentication
SecretKey.description_zh: 源站所属账号的SecretKey，当源站类型为OSS且源站鉴权类型为私有跨账号读，或者源站类型为S3且源站鉴权类型为私有读时有该参数

Version.description_en:
The signature algorithm version. This parameter is available when the origin type is S3 and the origin authentication type is private read. Valid values:
v2
v4

Default value: v4
Version.description_zh:
签名算法版本，当源站类型为S3且源站鉴权类型为私有读时有该参数，支持以下两种：
v2
v4

不传时，默认为v4

BizName.description_en:
The business scenario for record acceleration. Valid values:
image_video: Image and video.
api: API.
web: Web page
BizName.description_zh:
记录加速时的业务场景，取值：
image_video：视频图片。
api：api接口。
web：web网页

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the record. The date format follows the ISO 8601 standard and uses UTC time in the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
CreateTime.description_zh: 记录的创建时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

Data.description_en: The specific DNS information of the record. Different record types contain different information
Data.description_zh: 记录的具体DNS信息。不同类型记录包含不同的信息

Algorithm.description_en: The encryption algorithm used by the record. Valid values: 0 to 255. Exclusive to CERT and SSHFP records
Algorithm.description_zh: 记录所采用的加密算法，范围为0~255。CERT、SSHFP记录独有

Certificate.description_en: The public key certificate information of the record. Exclusive to CERT, SMIMEA, and TLSA records
Certificate.description_zh: 记录的公钥证书信息。CERT、SMIMEA和TLSA记录独有

Fingerprint.description_en: The public key fingerprint value of the record. Exclusive to SSHFP records
Fingerprint.description_zh: 记录的公钥指纹值。SSHFP记录独有

Flag.description_en: The flag of the record. The Flag of a CAA record indicates its priority and processing method. Valid values: 0 to 255. Exclusive to CAA records
Flag.description_zh: 记录的标志位。CAA记录的Flag指示其优先级和处理方式，取值范围为0~255。CAA记录独有

KeyTag.description_en: The public key identifier of the record. Valid values: 0 to 65535. Exclusive to CERT records
KeyTag.description_zh: 记录的公钥标识，范围为0~65535。CERT记录独有

MatchingType.description_en: The algorithm strategy used by the record for matching or verifying certificates. Valid values: 0 to 255. Exclusive to SMIMEA and TLSA records
MatchingType.description_zh: 记录用于匹配或验证证书的算法策略，范围为0~255。SMIMEA和TLSA记录独有

Port.description_en: The port of the record. Valid values: 0 to 65535. Exclusive to SRV records
Port.description_zh: 记录的端口，范围为0~65535。SRV记录独有

Priority.description_en: The priority of the record. Valid values: 0 to 65535. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Exclusive to MX, SRV, and URI records
Priority.description_zh: 记录的优先级，范围为 0~65535。数值越小，优先级越高。MX、SRV、URI记录独有

Selector.description_en: The type of certificate or public key used by the record. Valid values: 0 to 255. Exclusive to SMIMEA and TLSA records
Selector.description_zh: 记录所使用的证书或公钥的类型，范围为0~255。SMIMEA和TLSA记录独有

Tag.description_en: The tag of the record. The Tag of a CAA record indicates its specific type and purpose. Exclusive to CAA records
Tag.description_zh: 记录的标签。CAA记录的Tag表示其具体类型和用途。CAA记录独有

Type.description_en: The certificate type of the record (in CERT records), or the public key type (in SSHFP records)
Type.description_zh: 记录的证书类型（在CERT记录中），或公钥类型（在SSHFP记录中）

Usage.description_en: The usage identifier of the record. Valid values: 0 to 255. Exclusive to SMIMEA and TLSA records
Usage.description_zh: 记录的用途标识，范围为0~255。SMIMEA和TLSA记录独有

Value.description_en:
The record value or partial content. This parameter is included in A/AAAA, CNAME, NS, MX, TXT, CAA, SRV, and URI records. It has different meanings for different record types:

A/AAAA: The IP address pointed to. When there are multiple IPs, they are separated by commas (,). At least one IPv4 address is required.
CNAME: The target domain name pointed to.
NS: The name server for the specified domain.
MX: A valid target mail server domain name.
TXT: A valid text string.
CAA: A valid certificate authority domain name.
SRV: A valid target host domain name.
URI: A valid URI string
Value.description_zh:
记录值或部分内容。A/AAAA、CNAME、NS、MX、TXT、CAA、SRV、URI记录含有该参数。在不同类型的记录中，分别表示不同的含义：

A/AAAA：指向的ip地址。多个ip时，用半角逗号,分隔。至少需要有一个ipv4地址。
CNAME：指向的目标域名。
NS：指定域名的名称服务器。
MX:  有效的目标邮件服务器域名。
TXT：有效的文本字符串。
CAA：有效的证书颁发机构域名。
SRV：有效的目标主机域名。
URI: 有效的 URI 字符串

Weight.description_en: The weight of the record. Valid values: 0 to 65535. Exclusive to SRV and URI records
Weight.description_zh: 记录的权重，范围为0~65535。SRV、URI记录独有

HostPolicy.description_en:
The origin host policy. This takes effect when the record type is CNAME. It sets the policy for the host header used during origin requests. Two modes are available:

follow_hostname: Follow the request host.
follow_origin_domain: Follow the origin domain
HostPolicy.description_zh:
回源HOST策略，记录类型为CNAME时生效，设置回源时带HOST的策略，有两种模式：

follow_hostname: 跟随请求HOST。
follow_origin_domain: 跟随源站域名

Proxied.description_en:
Indicates whether proxy acceleration is enabled for the record. Valid values:

true: Proxy enabled.
false: Proxy acceleration disabled
Proxied.description_zh:
记录是否开启代理加速。取值：

true：开启代理。
false：关闭代理加速

RecordCname.description_en: The CNAME of the record. This is the CNAME value that needs to be configured for the record when the site access method is CNAME access
RecordCname.description_zh: 记录的CNAME。当站点的接入方式为CNAME接入时，需要为记录配置的CNAME值

RecordSourceType.description_en:
The origin type of the CNAME record. This parameter is required when adding a CNAME record. Valid values:

OSS: OSS origin.
S3: S3 origin.
LB: Load balancer origin.
OP: Origin pool.
Domain: Standard domain origin.

If this parameter is not specified or left empty, the default value is Domain, which indicates a standard domain origin type
RecordSourceType.description_zh:
CNAME记录的源站类型。添加CNAME记录时，需要填写此参数。取值：

OSS：OSS源站。
S3：S3源站。
LB：负载均衡器源站。
OP：源地址池源站。
Domain：普通域名源站。

该参数不传或传空时，则默认为Domain，即普通域名源站类型

RecordType.description_en: The DNS type of the record, such as A/AAAA, CNAME, TXT, etc

SiteId.description_en: The ID of the site to which the record belongs

SiteName.description_en: The name of the site to which the record belongs

Ttl.description_en: The TTL (Time to Live) of the record, in seconds. When the value is 1, it indicates that the TTL is set to automatic
Ttl.description_zh: 记录的过期时间，单位秒。当取值为1时，表示记录的过期时间为自动

UpdateTime.description_en: The update time of the record. The date format follows the ISO 8601 standard and uses UTC time in the format of yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
UpdateTime.description_zh: 记录的更新时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
